messages:
erin: Heads-up: PartnerOnramp marketplace tile goes live 08:00 PT tomorrow. We need a crisp partner-SEV lane that covers marketplace, SI hooks, and billing sync. Keep it short, machine-discoverable, and put a warm-watch in place for 48h.

sanjay: +1. Proposal: shared channel -> partner triage -> Redwood oncall -> partner eng. Timeline: 0-12m triage, 12-30m Redwood mitigation, 30-90m partner deep-dive/warroom.

marta: Agree. Recommend deterministic channel name so infra can autowire: #ponramp-ops.<env> (e.g. #ponramp-ops.prod). Pin a 1-pager with: contact list, routing map, warm-watch rota, rollback toggle, comms snippet.

kai: Ops-bot can scaffold and wire PD policies if we pass a simple payload. Example: 
```
/ops-bot scaffold ponramp-ops.prod --pins runbook.md,checklist.md --pd PD_MARKET,PD_BILLING --invite @erin,@sanjay,@marta,@kai
/ops-bot route alert.group=partneronramp.launch -> #ponramp-ops.prod
```

erin: Good. Also add region-fallback: if us-west oncall saturated then route to eu-oncall with tag "regional-failover". And capture customer_impact boolean in webhook payload.

sanjay: Warm-watch plan: first 12h -> 45m shifts, then 3hr checks up to 48h. Auto-post status every 30m during incidents: owner, surface, status, next_steps.

marta: I'll draft the pinned checklist and a one-line CSM comms snippet. Also adding a postmortem trigger rule: Sev2+ within 72h -> assign partner_eng_lead + release_manager.

ops-bot: action: /autocreate #ponramp-ops.prod when alert.group=="partneronramp.launch"; automation: if alert.severity=="P1" OR alert.surfaces_count>=2 -> create bridge partneronramp-warroom --ops @erin,@sanjay,@marta --duration 3h; page PD_MARKET,PD_BILLING

kai: Can we also include a tiny Slack workflow to capture incident metadata on first message? fields: region,severity,customer_impact,owner. Auto-pin that summary.

erin: Yes. After dry-run, I'll add one-sentence ops link to the announcement: "Ops path: #ponramp-ops.prod (warm-watch 48h). See pinned runbook for escalation and PD ids." I'll run dry-run tonight and report back. :thumbsup:
